records.source: This place is full of memories for me. Thank you so much for restoring it.$h
records.translation: 這個地方承載了我許多回憶。非常感謝你修復它。$h

records.source: Oh dear, is it an emergency? Why are you here?$s
records.translation: 天啊，是緊急狀況嗎？你為什麼會在這裡？$s

records.source: This is one of the newer traditions in Pelican Town... but we've taken to it rather quickly. Haven't we, George?
records.translation: 這是鵜鶘鎮比較新的傳統之一……但我們很快就喜歡上了。對吧，喬治？

records.source: Now now, dear... It's important that Doctor Harvey takes a good look at you. He's a nice young man! Behave yourself, for your dear old wife's sake.
records.translation: 好了，親愛的……讓哈維醫生替你好好檢查很重要。他是個好青年！看在你親愛老伴的分上，乖一點。

records.source: Could you check his lungs? He's been wheezing lately.
records.translation: 可以檢查一下他的肺嗎？他最近一直喘個不停。

records.source: When you get to be my age you have to see the doctor more often.
records.translation: 到了我這個年紀，就得更常看醫生。

records.source: Hmmpph... The wife's making me go to the clinic today.
records.translation: 哼……我老婆今天非要我來診所。

records.source: *grumble*... Good for nothing doctors... *grumble*
records.translation: *抱怨*……沒用的醫生……*抱怨*

records.source: I'm just here for the free coffee.
records.translation: 我只是為了免費咖啡來的。

records.source: I've never been religious but hey... I'm old.
records.translation: 我從來沒有宗教信仰，不過……我年紀大了。

records.source: Well how much longer do I have, Doc?
records.translation: 所以醫生，我還能活多久？

records.source: Hehehe... I skipped church to come here! I hope Yoba isn't too angry with me.$h
records.translation: 嘿嘿嘿……我翹掉禮拜跑來這裡！希望尤巴別太生我的氣。$h

records.source: I have to visit the doctor today, but I'm not afraid!
records.translation: 我今天要去看醫生，但我不害怕！

records.source: I wish I was old enough to see the mermaid show...$s
records.translation: 真希望我的年紀夠大，可以看美人魚表演……$s

records.source: Can you show me how this tool works, Doctor Harvey?
records.translation: 哈維醫生，你可以教我這個工具怎麼用嗎？

records.source: 1... 2... 3... 4... Here comes a wave! *giggle*$h
1... 2... 3... 4... Oh no! I messed up again.

I think Jas actually likes going to the doctor. What an unusual little girl.
records.translation: 我覺得賈斯其實喜歡看醫生。真是個與眾不同的小女孩。

records.source: Erm... Doctor Harvey? This is completely confidential, right?
records.translation: 呃……哈維醫生？這完全是保密的，對吧？

records.source: I'm going to sleep well tonight.$h
records.translation: 我今晚一定會睡得很好。$h

records.source: We're here for a 1:30pm appointment.
records.translation: 我們預約了下午 1:30。

records.source: Erm... Doctor Harvey? When you give her the shots, can we have two lollipops?
records.translation: 呃……哈維醫生？你替她打完針後，我們可以拿兩根棒棒糖嗎？

records.source: Oohh... Fine purple silk. You can't find that at JojaMart!
records.translation: 喔……上等紫色絲綢。這種東西在 Joja 超市可找不到！

records.source: Oh, Emily! I was hoping you'd show up!$h#$b#I was actually feeling a little lonely this morning.#$e#But I'm glad you're here!$h
records.translation: 喔，艾蜜莉！我一直希望你會來！$h#$b#今天早上我其實覺得有點寂寞。#$e#但我很高興你來了！$h

records.source: How's that Stardew Valley weather right now?#$e#The flowers there smell lovely.$h
records.translation: 星露谷現在的天氣怎麼樣？#$e#那裡的花聞起來真香。$h

records.source: It always seems to stay a little cooler by the lake.#$e#It's good to get out of the house now and then!$h
records.translation: 湖邊似乎總是比較涼快。#$e#偶爾出門走走真好！$h

records.source: Strange, isn't it?
records.translation: 很奇怪，對吧？

records.source: I think she sells some rare products.
records.translation: 我想她有賣一些稀有商品。

records.source: I had a great time.$h#$b#Thanks for being my friend.$h#$e#Come back again any time!$h
records.translation: 我玩得很開心。$h#$b#謝謝你願意當我的朋友。$h#$e#隨時都可以再來！$h

records.source: It's nothing serious... I'm just here for my annual check-up.
records.translation: 沒什麼嚴重的……我只是來做年度健康檢查。

records.source: Well... my nose has been a little runny, Doctor. But otherwise I'm doing fine!
records.translation: 這個嘛……醫生，我最近有點流鼻水。不過其他方面都很好！

records.source: It's too cold to get out of bed.
records.translation: 天氣太冷了，我不想下床。

records.source: Hi, honey! I'm mostly just here to visit Emily.
records.translation: 嗨，親愛的！我主要是來看看艾蜜莉。

records.source: The weather's too horrible to get out of bed.
records.translation: 天氣太糟糕了，我不想下床。

records.source: The cold air isn't so bad if you bundle up!$h
records.translation: 只要穿暖一點，冷空氣就沒那麼可怕！$h

records.source: It's too cold to get out of bed.

records.source: This stuff can definitely be incorporated into a healthy diet.
records.translation: 這些東西絕對可以納入健康飲食。

records.source: Hi Honey. What are you doing at the clinic?#$e#Ah, you just came to see me. That's nice.$h
records.translation: 嗨，親愛的。你來診所做什麼？#$e#啊，你只是來看我。真好。$h

records.source: I'm just putting away these groceries.
records.translation: 我只是在把這些雜貨收起來。

records.source: The sound of running water is relaxing for me.
records.translation: 流水聲能讓我放鬆。

records.source: Hi! I'm just shopping for some essentials, so I can continue to cook healthy meals for us.
records.translation: 嗨！我只是來買些必需品，這樣就能繼續為我們烹調健康餐點。

records.source: I'm just putting away these groceries.
records.translation: 我只是在把這些雜貨收起來。

records.source: Winter can be a dreary season, but events like this make it a little brighter!
records.translation: 冬季可能很陰鬱，但這樣的活動能讓它明亮一些！
